name: URTC-SMART-RACK
build: bash build_firmware.sh. Real host-native unit tests run before the arm-none-eabi-gcc cross-compile.
notes: Functional v0: real, hardware-independent pure-C logic (tool_id.c ID decoding, lifecycle.c usage/maintenance tracking, preheat.c Smart Idle activation + target temperature) with 25 host-native test assertions, plus the verified cross-compile toolchain (arm-none-eabi-gcc -> .bin/.hex with a real size report). Real CAN/F-RAM/GPIO I/O to actually drive tool tracking and pre-heating needs a real PCB, which doesn't exist yet.
